projectState.summary: Track A3 is approved and merged to main. The durable Claude review artifact from claude/codex-a3-selection-code-review was cherry-picked, and the A1+A2+A3 candidate-store engine is complete. A3 adds per-kind selectCandidates() to the candidate store, using deterministic fitness/generation/created_at/id ordering to mark top eliteLimit candidates elite and purge overflow with candidate.retained/candidate.purged audit events carrying reason:"selection" and rank. Carry forward: selection is strict elitism and should get a diversity lever later; A4 must deep-clone genomes, create new ids with parentId and generation+1, and never mutate elites in place. Next: Track A4 development hook.
